page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7.32xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 128 dedicated physical cores with 128 vCPUs, indicating a configuration of 1.0 thread per core. The processing power is delivered by Intel Xeon 8369B processors operating at a base frequency of 2.7 GHz.

The instance is equipped with 512.0 GB of system memory, yielding a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per physical core. It does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline network bandwidth of 64 Gbps, though the instance does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Lacking integrated GPUs and local NVMe storage, the ecs.g7.32xlarge is designed for workloads that rely heavily on high-density CPU processing and network-attached storage rather than local disk I/O or hardware acceleration. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent compute performance without resource contention. This profile is suited for large-scale general-purpose workloads, enterprise applications, distributed caching, and web serving architectures that require high network throughput and substantial parallel processing capacity.
